name: Google Maps / Places
label: Google Maps / Places
description: Google Maps / Places official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: geocode, reverse_geocode, elevation, timezone. Docs: https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/geocoding/overview. Maps Platform Terms. Billing per SKU. Places API (New) and Routes need X-Goog-FieldMask — OfficialApiNode v1 ships Geocoding/Elevation/Timezone GET. Do not scrape Google Maps. Do not call legacy Directions/Distance Matrix on new projects. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Maps / Places request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"geocode"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: geocode | reverse_geocode | elevation | timezone. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'geocode'.

schema.label: address
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `address` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `language` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: latlng
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `latlng` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: location
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `location` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: locations
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `locations` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: region
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `region` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `timestamp` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: Bounds
schema.description: Geocode bounds bias as sw|ne lat,lng. geocode. Example: 34.1,-118.5|34.3,-118.2.

schema.label: Location type
schema.description: reverse_geocode location_type. EXACT: ROOFTOP | RANGE_INTERPOLATED | GEOMETRIC_CENTER | APPROXIMATE.

schema.label: Path
schema.description: elevation path — sampled path as lat,lng|lat,lng. Use with samples.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: geocode, reverse_geocode, elevation, timezone.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
